summary_1line: Aswatthaman rebukes Duryodhana yet vows loyalty, devastates Panchala warriors, and enters a fierce duel of insults and arrows with Dhrishtadyumna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Aswatthaman, blazing with anger, stands in his chariot as torrents of arrows rain upon him like a storm while he calmly counters them.
Dhrishtadyumna on a golden chariot points his bow at Aswatthaman and publicly challenges him amid the chaos of fleeing Panchala warriors.
Arrows with golden wings strike into Aswatthaman’s body like swarming bees entering a flowering tree as he glares back in fury.
